findings.meaning: Each assignment records grades and daily instructional periods. Multiple classes require separate position records, illustrated by one teacher assigned chemistry and biology.
An exiting or internally transferring employee receives an end date but remains on the school site report for the fiscal year.
Substitute teachers are entered after four consecutive weeks in the same position.

inference: These rules motivate assignment-level deduplication and active-date filtering. They do not establish the exact cause of the V81 dashboard overlap, the FY2025 rules, or its aggregation code.
